summary: Update template-formula-fill skill to address three failure modes from the trace: (1) QUARTILE.INC parameter mapping (1=25th, 3=75th) was not explicit, causing wrong percentile values; (2) no guidance on write-order safety when writing multiple formula blocks, leading to accidental cell overwrites; (3) missing explicit statistics row-to-function mapping for the 6-row statistics block pattern. These are implementation-level gaps that caused 3 separate fix iterations.
